description: The bar chart illustrates the performance gain (in percentage points) of three large vision-language models — GPT-4o, Claude-3.5-Sonnet, and Qwen2-72B-VL — under two conditions: “Strong Supervision” (represented by hatched blue bars) and an unlabeled condition (represented by solid light blue bars), as evaluated in the context of the VisuoThink framework for enhancing LVLM reasoning via multimodal tree search. The vertical axis, labeled “Performance Gain (+%)”, ranges from 0 to 30 with major tick marks at intervals of 5. For GPT-4o, the “Strong Supervision” bar reaches approximately 24.5%, while the unlabeled bar is around 5%. For Claude-3.5-Sonnet, the “Strong Supervision” bar is at about 9.5%, and the unlabeled bar is approximately 3.5%. For Qwen2-72B-VL, the “Strong Supervision” bar is around 15%, and the unlabeled bar is about 5.5%. The chart visually emphasizes that “Strong Supervision” consistently yields substantially higher performance gains across all three models compared to the unlabeled condition, with GPT-4o showing the largest absolute gain under strong supervision. The legend at the top indicates that the hatched blue bar corresponds to “Strong Supervision”, while the solid light blue bar represents the baseline or unlabeled condition, though the latter is not explicitly labeled in the legend.
